meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的目标拆成超细步骤，每步都要在真实界面留下证据才算完成；它先读工作流手册、注册目标、用清单跟踪，并在长任务中委托子代理并行干活。
howto.when: 当你说“ulw-loop”“ulw”等关键词，或要求持久目标执行、基于证据的工作、手动QA、带检查点的长期交付时触发。

say.text: 开始 ulw-loop，把“搭建个人博客”分解成带证据的步骤。
say.note: Claude 会读取工作流并生成带证据的执行清单。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式执行这个长期任务，并在每步记录证据。
say.note: Claude 会按证据规则逐项执行并更新状态。

say.text: 进入 ulw-loop，先读工作流说明并创建目标。
say.note: Claude 会先阅读参考文档再注册目标。

howto.what_en: This skill makes Claude decompose a goal into granular, evidence-bound steps and execute them sequentially: it first reads the workflow manual, registers goals, tracks progress via CLI state, verifies each step against a real surface, delegates subtasks to subagents, and follows stop rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "ulw-loop", "ulw", or asks for durable goal execution, evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop and decompose "build a personal blog" into evidence-bound steps.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow and generates an evidence-bound task list.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to execute this long-running task and record evidence at each step.
say_en.note: Claude follows evidence rules and updates state per step.

say_en.text: Enter ulw-loop, first read the workflow docs and create the goal.
say_en.note: Claude reads the reference before registering the goal.
